text:
Maya: Heads-up — planning to deploy routing-v3 to prod at 11:30 PT today. This deploy includes the new routing cache + small schema change and a few observability updates: dashboard panels for route latency, increased trace sampling for the critical path, and a relaxed error-rate alert while we watch. Please ack if you have objections or need a rollback window.

Devon: ack from infra. I’ll own the rollout and smoke checks. Targeting a 3-min canary then full.

Chris: pinging oncall about dashboard changes. I added a new Grafana row: "routing-v3 — 99th p50/p95 latency, KV cache hit ratio". Will post link after deploy.

Priya: quick note on alerts — raising the error-rate threshold from 0.5% -> 1.0% for the routing service for 2h post-deploy to avoid noisy pages while we validate. Will revert automatically after 2h. If you want a longer window speak now.

Maya: thanks. Smoke checklist (short):
- curl health endpoint on 3 prod hosts
- run a small synthetic trace (see snippet)
- validate KV cache hit ratio > 70% within 10m

Devon: smoke curl:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" "https://prod-eu.redwood/graphql?query={_health{status}}"
```
Expect {"status":"ok"}.

Ava: I’ll watch traces and increase sampling: set jaeger sampling rate from 0.1 -> 0.5 for routing service during rollout. If traces blow up, revert to 0.1.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for routing-v3 at 2026-03-17T18:30:00Z (initiator: Maya). CI: green, canary: off.

Chris: Dashboards I added: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd123/routing-overview (panel ids: 7,8,12). I tweaked the alert to use a rolling 5m window.

Priya: runbook link for rollback if things go sideways: https://confluence.internal/infra/runbooks/routing-rollback. TL;DR: revert routing-config tag, scale down new pods, switch traffic to previous model.

Maya: plan:
- 11:30 PT start canary (3 instances)
- 11:33 PT smoke checks by Devon
- 11:45 PT if canary ok -> ramp to 100% over 10m
- 1h watch window, then auto revert of alert threshold if stable

Devon: I’ll post a short status update in 10m increments. If I don’t, assume I’m investigating and @Priya will take over.

Priya: ack. I’ll be on standby for rollback.

Chris: +1. I’ll keep an eye on the Grafana row and traces. If error-rate > 0.8% for 2 consecutive 5m buckets, I’ll call rollback.

Devon: small note — increasing request tracing can cause trace storage spikes. Ava, can you add a quick retention tweak?

Ava: done. Temporarily bumping retention TTL for routing traces to 7d from 3d for the next 24h.

Maya: thanks all. If anyone sees anything critical during canary throw a :rotating_light: and ping @oncall. Otherwise I’ll post final status after ramp.

Devon: starting canary in 3.

[later]

Devon: canary healthy. health endpoints ok, synthetic trace looks good, cache hit 76% (measured at +8m). Ramping now.

Chris: watching dashboards — latency stable, no error spike.

Priya: on standby but no action needed.

Devon: rolling to 100% complete at 11:58 PT. All checks green. Keeping the raised alert threshold for the 1h watch window.

Maya: great job. I’ll close the deploy and revert the alert change at 12:58 PT if stable.

Devon: noted. Closing thread. :tada:
